name: Skeuomorphism
what_it_means: Skeuomorphism imitates real-world materials and objects: leather, brushed metal, wood, paper, glossy buttons and realistic lighting. It was the signature of early iPhone apps and is making a comeback as 'tactile' design, giving users instantly familiar, satisfying controls.
signature_moves: Realistic textures: metal, leather, wood, paper
best_for: Audio/music tools, camera apps, retro-tech products, games
prompt_template: B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ] ** Design a vintage synthesizer/audio plugin interface for [APP] in full Skeuomorphism. A brushed aluminium faceplate (layered linear gradients with fine noise) set inside walnut wood side panels. Include realistic rotary knobs with metallic radial highlights and tick marks, a glowing amber VU meter with a needle, chunky toggle switches, and embossed engraved labels (text-shadow 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5)). Use realistic top down lighting, screws in the corners, and soft drop shadows so every control looks touchable. Font: Helvetica Neue, small caps labels.
